Public extract supplied by Geofabrik. The source timestamp, SHA-256 and
download URL are in index.json. The machine-readable derived database is
distributed here as index.json and its listed JSON sectors.

end elevation samples derived from MDT05/MDT25: © IGN/CNIG, CC BY 4.0.
